description: This file contains a Kotlin test class 'StartupMacrobenchmark' that performs benchmark tests on app startup and UI scrolling performance using Android's macrobenchmark library. It includes two test methods: one for measuring cold startup time and another for measuring frame timing during scroll, utilizing Android's UI Automator for interactions.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: A test class that benchmarks app startup time and scroll performance using macrobenchmark library. It has two test methods: coldStartup() for measuring cold launch and startupAndScrollFrameTiming() for measuring frame timing during scrolling.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Performs a benchmark measurement of app cold startup time, invoking the measureRepeated method with StartupMode.COLD and other parameters.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Performs a benchmark measurement of UI frame timing during scrolling, starting the activity and performing swipe gestures.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Utility method to execute benchmark code, skipping the test if known device issues are detected based on exception messages.
